summary: Correct the detransitive gloss to entwöhnt werden
rationale: This sense is explicitly detransitive, with forms fṭīm/məfṭəm. Its sole example has the growing child as subject ('w yariwo hul də-fṭimo'), translated 'es wuchs heran, bis zur Entwöhnung'. The child is weaned; it does not wean someone else. The current active German infinitive assigns the opposite participant role.
